title: UI Engineer
text:
About Tilda Research, Inc.

About Tilda

Tilda Research is reimagining how clinical trials are run by bringing AI-native tools and AI teammates into clinical research operations. Our technology works alongside sponsor, CRO, and research teams to simplify study management, improve data quality, support real-time oversight, and help accelerate trial timelines.

We are building the future of clinical trial execution: one where research teams can spend less time on administrative bottlenecks and more time focused on patients, sites, and the work that moves new treatments forward. Tilda’s mission is rooted in the belief that clinical research should be faster, more efficient, more scalable, and more accessible — without losing the human judgment and care that patients and research teams deserve.

At Tilda, we are a team of builders, operators, researchers, and problem-solvers working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and AI. We move quickly, think deeply, and care about building products and systems that create meaningful impact in the clinical research industry.

About the Role

Tilda Research is looking for a talented UI Engineer to help build modern, intuitive, and high-performance user experiences for our AI-powered clinical research platform.

In this role, you will translate complex data, clinical workflows, and product requirements into elegant, scalable web interfaces. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build polished, production-ready applications that make clinical research workflows simpler and more efficient.

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong React and TypeScript expertise, excellent UI/UX instincts, hands-on experience building component libraries and design systems, and practical experience using modern AI development tools.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where ownership, creativity, collaboration, and rapid execution are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Build Modern User Interfaces: Design, develop, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies.

Develop Component Libraries & Design Systems: Build reusable UI components, establish consistent design patterns, and contribute to scalable frontend architecture.

Translate Designs into Production Experiences: Collaborate with Product and Design to transform product requirements, wireframes, and prototypes into polished, intuitive interfaces.

Integrate APIs & AI-Powered Workflows: Connect frontend applications with backend services, REST APIs, and AI-powered capabilities, including interactive workflows, document processing, and human-in-the-loop experiences.

Leverage AI Development Tools: Actively use AI coding and development tools to accelerate implementation, prototyping, debugging, testing, and code quality while maintaining engineering standards.

Optimize Performance & Quality: Deliver clean, maintainable, well-tested code while improving application performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and usability.

Own Frontend Features End-to-End: Take responsibility for frontend features from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

Must have solid English Communication Skills is required 

5+ years of professional frontend or UI engineering experience.

Strong hands-on expertise with React and TypeScript.

Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design.

Demonstrated experience building and maintaining reusable component libraries and design systems.

Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.

Strong understanding of frontend architecture, state management, asynchronous data handling, and error handling.

Excellent attention to UI/UX quality, visual consistency, and interaction design.

Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude

About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.
Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.
About the role
We are looking for a Finance Developer to join our team and help build an internal web platform that supports portfolio management for our finance and operations teams. Working at the intersection of
finance and technology, you will turn financial data and business requirements into accurate, reliable tools. You will own features from end to end, from data queries and calculation logic through to the user interface.
What you'll do

Design, build and maintain platform features, including summary metrics, interactive tables and data visualisations.

Translate financial methodologies such as valuation, P&L attribution, exposure and cost basis into clean, well-tested backend logic.

Make sure every figure reconciles accurately against source systems and existing reporting.

Write and optimise SQL queries against our cloud data warehouse.

Keep the platform fast and reliable through caching, performance tuning and robust error handling.

Work closely with finance and operations stakeholders to gather requirements, validate results and deliver improvements.

Our stack

Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Google BigQuery, Redis

Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Recharts, Tailwind CSS

Infrastructure: Google Cloud (Cloud Run), Google sign-in

Requirements

Solid professional experience with Python, including building backend services or data applications.

A good understanding of financial concepts: positions, P&L (daily, MTD, YTD, ITD), NAV, exposure and cost basis.

Comfort writing non-trivial SQL, ideally on BigQuery or another cloud warehouse.

A strong eye for detail and a habit of testing and reconciling numbers until they're right.

Clear communication, and the confidence to challenge and clarify requirements with finance teams.

A MSc in Finance, or progress towards a professional qualification such as CFA or CAIA (Level I or above), or equivalent.

Advantageous

Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, especially data-heavy UIs.

Experience with BI and reporting tools, or building analytics dashboards.

A background in asset management, fund administration, treasury or fintech.

Familiarity with multi-asset portfolios, e.g. equities, fixed income, digital assets and commodities.

Experience with Google Cloud and caching strategies.
